comparison.objective: Remove an interrupted suture using forceps and a stitch cutter, then place the stitch and return the tools.
comparison.physical_skill: Millimetric knot lifting, under-strand cutter insertion, cutting, and direction-controlled extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Correct leg cut within 1 mm of skin, stitch drawn toward the wound without excessive opening, deposited on gauze, tools returned, and no tissue damage.
comparison.reason: Microscale two-tool cutting and extraction are materially different from moving-carton handling; generic bimanual coordination does not establish overlap.
